## Project Summary

**What it is:**
A seven-day remediation planner for nursing students. It reads a JSON file of missed exam topics and generates a balanced study plan that spreads topics across days, ensuring no day has more than two topics from the same client-need category. Runs locally in Python with no network access.

**Rules anyone must follow:**
- **Standard library only** — no external dependencies
- **JSON storage only** — no database
- **Never include actual paid qbank question text** (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan) — topic tags and personal notes only; non-negotiable
- All plan content must stay within PN scope of practice (reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan)
- Keep 7 days as the default
- No GitHub/packaging; stays local
- No gamification (streaks/leaderboards parked for now)
- Maintain the output format as-is
- Must be readable in a text editor on a phone
